```lisp
; Durative actions for preparing the living room and snack
(:durative-action prepare-living-room-and-snack
  :parameters (?robot ?lightSwitch ?curtains ?television ?popcorn ?microwave ?fridge ?drink)
  :duration (= ?duration 10) ; Example duration, adjust as needed
  :condition (and
    (at start (not (inaction ?robot)))
    (at start (at ?popcorn ?microwave))
    (at start (at ?drink ?fridge))
  )
  :effect (and
    ; Dim the lights
    (at start (at ?robot ?lightSwitch))
    (at start (switch-off ?robot ?lightSwitch))

    ; Adjust the curtains
    (at start (at ?robot ?curtains))
    (at start (object-close ?robot ?curtains))

    ; Set up the television
    (at start (at ?robot ?television))
    (at start (switch-on ?robot ?television))

    ; Make popcorn
    (at start (at ?robot ?popcorn))
    (at start (holding ?robot ?popcorn))
    (at start (at ?robot ?microwave))
    (at start (at ?popcorn ?microwave))
    (at start (switch-on ?robot ?microwave))
    (at end (switch-off ?robot ?microwave))

    ; Get a drink
    (at start (at ?robot ?fridge))
    (at start (object-open ?robot ?fridge))
    (at start (holding ?robot ?drink))
  )
)

; Example initial state and goal state
(:init
  (not (inaction robot1))
  (at popcorn microwave)
  (at drink fridge)
)

(:goal
  (and
    (switch-off robot1 lightSwitch)
    (object-close robot1 curtains)
    (switch-on robot1 television)
    (at popcorn microwave)
    (holding robot1 drink)
  )
)
```
